live_incident_2026.description: Separate from the trajectory simulation above: distil shipped the same class of bug (naive recompression busting the prefix cache) once on the live adapter, before 1.45 -- a recency carve-out that rewrote an already-committed prefix one turn late produced zero cache reads on every turn and cost 2x direct (uncompressed) on the real Anthropic API. The invariant is now enforced (suffix-only, cache-monotonic compression). Full writeup, live numbers: docs/cache-contract.html.
